title.value: Renewal Monte Carlo: Renewal theory based reinforcement learning
title.justification: The title clearly indicates the focus of the paper on Renewal Monte Carlo methods, which relates to applying renewal theory to reinforcement learning.
title.quote: In this paper, we propose a Monte Carlo method—which we call Renewal Monte Carlo (RMC)—for infinite horizon Markov decision processes with designated start state.

analysis.description: This paper presents an online reinforcement learning algorithm named Renewal Monte Carlo (RMC) intended for infinite horizon Markov decision processes. The proposed method harnesses the advantages of Monte Carlo algorithms while mitigating their typical drawbacks, specifically high variance and delayed updates. The use of renewal theory allows for a low-variance, online approach that facilitates policy improvement whenever the system revisits the start state.
